<script>
const obs=new IntersectionObserver((e)=>{e.forEach(x=>{if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add("visible");x.target.querySelectorAll(".card-clean,.eq-card,.spec,.inc-item,.photo-cell,.page-link-item").forEach((el,i)=>{el.style.opacity="0";el.style.transform="translateY(16px)";el.style.transition=`opacity .6s ${i*.1}s ease,transform .6s ${i*.1}s ease`;setTimeout(()=>{el.style.opacity="1";el.style.transform="translateY(0)"},i*100);});}});},{threshold:0.08});
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>document.getElementById("mainNav").classList.toggle("scrolled",scrollY>80));

function openPanel(n){document.getElementById("panelBarco").classList.add("open");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";}
function closePanel(n){document.getElementById("panelBarco").classList.remove("open");document.body.style.overflow="";}

const EX={
  morning:{label:"Salida matutina",title:"Morning <em>Escape</em>",price:"230 € + 150 € combustible",meta:"09:30 – 13:30 · 4 horas · Hasta 8 personas"},
  sunset:{label:"Atardecer dorado",title:"Sunset <em>Experience</em>",price:"280 € + 150 € combustible",meta:"16:30 – 20:30 · 4 horas · Hasta 8 personas"},
  fullday:{label:"Día completo",title:"Full Day <em>Experience</em>",price:"380 € + 150 € combustible",meta:"10:00 – 18:00 · 8 horas · Hasta 8 personas"}
};
let cur="morning";
function openModal(k){cur=k;const d=EX[k];document.getElementById("mLabel").textContent=d.label;document.getElementById("mTitle").innerHTML=d.title;document.getElementById("mPrice").textContent=d.price;document.getElementById("mMeta").textContent=d.meta;document.getElementById("modalBg").classList.add("open");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById("modalBg").classList.remove("open");document.body.style.overflow="";}
function closeModalBg(e){if(e.target===document.getElementById("modalBg"))closeModal();}
async function sendReserva(){
  const name=document.getElementById("fName").value||"Sin nombre";
  const date=document.getElementById("fDate").value||"Fecha por confirmar";
  const pax=document.getElementById("fPax").value;
  const phone=document.getElementById("fPhone").value||"Sin teléfono";
  const email=document.getElementById("fEmail").value||"";
  const d=EX[cur];

  // Enviar a Formspree (email)
  try {
    await fetch("https://formspree.io/f/xpqnlroo", {
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({
        excursion: d.label,
        precio: d.price,
        horario: d.meta,
        nombre: name,
        fecha: date,
        personas: pax,
        telefono: phone,
        email: email
      })
    });
  } catch(e) { console.log("Formspree error:", e); }

  // Abrir WhatsApp
  const msg=encodeURIComponent(`Hola Marcos! Quiero reservar:\n\n🚢 ${d.label}\n📅 ${date}\n👥 ${pax} persona(s)\n💶 ${d.price}\n\nNombre: ${name}\nContacto: ${phone}`);
  window.open(`https://wa.me/34677343548?text=${msg}`,"_blank");
}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"){closeModal();closePanel();}});
</script>
